STORYTIME ADVENTURE 19 · CLASS 29

Fox’s Story Shadow Mystery

Age 4–5 YearsClass 29 · StorytimeSkill Reading picture clues

Muddy footprints, an empty cookie plate, a tipped flowerpot — three mysteries, solved with clues.

Play the story game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · READING PICTURE CLUES

Fox’s Story Shadow Mystery

Detective Fox has three mysteries! Look at each clue picture, then tap what really happened.

Muddy footprints walk in from the garden door. Who made them?

The cookie plate is empty — only crumbs are left. Who ate the cookies?

The flowerpot is tipped over and the kitten ran. What happened?

Case closed!

The puppy tracked mud, the boy ate the cookies, and the kitten tipped the pot. Mystery solved!

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Each round shows one clue and two possible stories. The clue rules out one of them, and saying WHY out loud (“the footprints are muddy, so it was the puppy!”) is the inference skill growing in real time.

Prefer paper? The Fox’s Story Shadow Mystery worksheet prints the same story with room to retell and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
